about: Grades of the photos checked by eye (review.py): 3 best, 2 usable but plain, 1 reject. Commons photos graded min_grade or more reach the index, and a company's Commons photos graded 2 fill the places its better photos leave free (marked plain). Unsplash and Pexels photos are published unless graded below min_grade. The build never picks a photo graded below min_grade again.
